```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Question 1
```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
summary(ny_noaa)
```
This data set has 7 variables and 2,595,176 rows of data. Key variables include, id, data, prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, and tmin. There are quite a lot of NA values, especially in the tmax and tmin variables. 

```{r}
# Data Cleaning and Converting Units
ny_noaa <- 
  ny_noaa |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    day = day(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10, 
    prcp = prcp / 10
  )
summary(ny_noaa)
```
prcp: Precipitation (tenths of mm)
snow: Snowfall (mm)
temp: (tenths of degrees C)
